proposition: At its end the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk predicts, from the name Shāh Rukh (R = 200, Kh = 600, sum 800), that the Timurid-Shahrukhid state will last to the end of the 9th Islamic century, linking the name to the divine name al-Ẓāhir; MK's other note on it says the prediction gives the state one century.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: MK's translation of the closing section; the edition is in his Part 2, T.4.1
